output.summary: A user six months into long covid asked for an honest view on whether they will recover. The bot gave a candid outlook, explained post-exertional malaise and pacing, touched on work adjustments, and gave points to raise with the GP. The user said they would start pacing and tracking and called it the first conversation that had not made them feel worse.
